title: FRM-* items
summary: Bicycle frame components across model lines, sizes, and colours stocked at Manchester and Leeds stores for production assembly.
body:
The `FRM-*` family encompasses all structural bicycle frames used across Northbridge Cycles production lines, spanning models such as Ancoats, Deansgate, Medlock, Irk, Tamworth, Rochdale, and Spryte [^r52]. All frame items are classified under category RAW with lead-time code LC 0 [^r52]. Stock is held and issued primarily out of Manchester stores (WH-MAN-STR) and Leeds stores (WH-LDS-STR) to support manufacturing work orders [^r1][^r2][^r65].

| Field | Detail |
|---|---|
| Item Family | FRM |
| Category | RAW [^r52] |
| Lead Time Code | LC 0 [^r52] |
| Stock Locations | WH-MAN-STR, WH-LDS-STR [^r1][^r2] |

## Product lines and procurement

Frame components cover multiple bicycle model lines with distinct geometries, sizes (S, M, L, XL), and colour finishes:

* **Ancoats (`FRM-ANC-*`)**: Procured from suppliers including VF-MAN-0573, BTF-BIE-1121, UF-WIG-0746, and CF-COV-0735 [^r28][^r29][^r39][^r51]. Orders include 18,000 units of `FRM-ANC-S-RED` on PO/2026/00258 at £162.13, 2,400 units of `FRM-ANC-M-BLU` on PO/2026/00702 at £171.92, 5,000 units of `FRM-ANC-L-BLK` on PO/2026/00857 at £140.34, and 225 units of `FRM-ANC-S-GRN` on PO/2026/01181 at £129.70 for [[cc-prd-04|PRD-04]] [^r28][^r36][^r39][^r51]. PO/2026/00859 held an order with Calder Fabrications for 150 units of `FRM-ANC-M-BLK` at £156.60 [^r53][^r56].
* **Deansgate (`FRM-DEA-*`)**: Designed for step-through frames [^r52]. Recent purchases include `FRM-DEA-M-RED` at £91.77 on PO/2026/00192, 75 units and 225 units of `FRM-DEA-L-BLU` at £87.26 from EF-BIR-0672 under PO/2026/01035 and PO/2026/01083 for Leeds assembly, and 11,200 units of `FRM-DEA-S-RED` on PO/2026/01178 from ŁF-ODZ-0708 at £173.65 (£2,333,856.00 gross) charged to [[cc-prd-07|PRD-07]] [^r26][^r45][^r50]. Bowland Fabrications holds open order PO/2026/00293 for 225 units of `FRM-DEA-XL-GRN` [^r53].
* **Medlock (`FRM-MED-*`)**: Orders include 12,000 units of `FRM-MED-S-RED` on PO/2026/01028 from UF-WIG-0746 at £143.91 (£1,726,920.00 basic value), alongside smaller batches of `FRM-MED-S-GRN` (£184.30), `FRM-MED-S-BLU` (£100.31), `FRM-MED-M-SLV` (£99.04), and `FRM-MED-XL-BLU` (£130.86) [^r26][^r32][^r43][^r59].
* **Irk (`FRM-IRK-*`)**: Sourced for multiple lines including [[cc-prd-02|PRD-02]], [[cc-prd-03|PRD-03]], [[cc-prd-05|PRD-05]], and [[cc-lds-prd-01|LDS-PRD-01]] [^r31][^r37][^r48][^r49]. Procurements include 1,200 units of `FRM-IRK-M-SLV` from BTF-BIE-1121 on PO/2026/00383 at £187.83, 900 units of `FRM-IRK-S-BLK` on PO/2026/00711 from NF-DER-0456 at £141.26, 50 units of `FRM-IRK-S-RED` on PO/2026/01016 from TF-TAI-0460 at £141.71, 1,200 units of `FRM-IRK-L-SLV` on PO/2026/01040 from BF-SAL-0757 at £203.29, 225 units of `FRM-IRK-XL-BLK` on PO/2026/01156 from HTF-NEW-0332 at £109.89, and 2,400 units of `FRM-IRK-L-BLK` on PO/2026/01163 from EF-BIR-0672 at £145.81 [^r31][^r37][^r41][^r46][^r48][^r49].
* **Tamworth (`FRM-TAM-*`)**: Sourced from BF-SAL-0757, CF-COV-0446, CF-COV-0735, and HTF-NEW-0332 [^r27][^r34][^r42][^r47]. Purchases include 5,000 units of `FRM-TAM-S-GRN` on PO/2026/00251 at £193.83, 2,400 units of `FRM-TAM-S-BLU` on PO/2026/00653 at £115.64, 400 units of `FRM-TAM-L-RED` on PO/2026/01027 at £183.63, and 2,500 units of `FRM-TAM-M-RED` on PO/2026/01068 at £144.37 approved by DOKAFOR for PRD-03 [^r27][^r34][^r42][^r47]. Open order PO/2026/00882 with Bowland Fabrications holds 11,200 units of `FRM-TAM-S-GRN` [^r53].
* **Rochdale (`FRM-ROC-*`)**: Orders include 11,200 units of `FRM-ROC-M-RED` on PO/2026/00602 from Calder Fabrications at £136.83 (£1,838,995.20 total) for LDS-PRD-01, 300 units of `FRM-ROC-XL-BLU` on PO/2026/00644 from BF-SAL-0757 at £191.66, and 11,200 units of `FRM-ROC-XL-RED` on PO/2026/01033 from EF-BIR-0672 at £177.41 approved by [[user-hweber|Henrik Weber (HWEBER)]] [^r33][^r44][^r55].
* **Spryte (`FRM-SPR-*`)**: Major orders include 40,500 units of `FRM-SPR-S-BLU` on PO/2026/00717 from TF-TAI-0460 at £111.10 each (£5,399,460.00 gross under VAT20-RC) for LDS-PRD-01, 1,600 units of `FRM-SPR-XL-BLU` on PO/2026/00328 from HTF-NEW-0332 at £114.11 for PRD-03, and 50 units of `FRM-SPR-M-BLK` on PO/2026/00687 at £205.76 on ADV payment terms [^r30][^r35][^r38][^r54].

## Stock on hand and ledger movements

As of 26 October 2026 at 09:00, balances across warehouses include:

* `FRM-ANC-S-BLK`: WH-MAN-STR holds 11,764 units on hand (343 allocated, 4,000 on order) [^r1]. Its balance opened Q3 2026 at 31,567 units, was issued against work orders such as WO/2026/05762, and stood at 11,764 on 30 September 2026 [^r83][^r84][^r85].
* `FRM-ANC-S-BLU`: WH-MAN-STR holds 35,474 on hand and 1,492 allocated against an ROL of 12,600 and an ADI of 900 [^r60]. Stock opened Q3 at 77,356 units and fell to 35,474 on 30 September 2026 following repeated production issues [^r86][^r87].
* `FRM-ANC-S-RED`: Opened Q3 at 21,024 units in WH-MAN-STR, drawing down through regular issues to 1,549 units on 30 September 2026 [^r88][^r89][^r91].
* `FRM-ANC-M-BLK`: WH-LDS-STR holds 19 on hand (0 allocated, 0 on order) [^r2].
* `FRM-ANC-M-BLU`: WH-MAN-STR received receipts of 800 units under GRN/2026/29618, GRN/2026/29708, and GRN/2026/29733, closing September 2026 at 2,419 units [^r78][^r79][^r81].
